summary: Maris Tech Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 20, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing the completion of full 360-degree HD video stitching with thermal-day image fusion on its Diamond Ultra platform. The press release details a product enhancement, not a special situation. The filing is a routine report of a foreign private issuer for the month, with no mention of any M&A, capital restructuring, or other corporate event.
